short_source_excerpts.text: we store only a subset of gradients from each task in our experiments
the larger the learning rate, the more likely a gradient update violates the locality assumption

references.verified_method: Project gradients away from a span of stored output-logit gradients, with local substitution of earlier model gradients and practical subset/target-logit variants.
scope_limits: The current-to-stored model-gradient substitution is explicitly approximate/local.
Stored subsets do not certify every legal input or every program execution.
Lemma 3.1 concerns projected descent for the new-task loss; no fixed-graph BF16/FP32 bitwise or serial-publication theorem is supplied by that inspected result.

references.verified_method: Build representation matrices from sampled layer activations, retain SVD directions by a Frobenius-energy threshold, project later gradients away, and append new orthogonal task directions.
scope_limits: A sampled, threshold-truncated representation span is not a proof of all-legal-activation containment.
Exact Delta W x = 0 preserves exact linear action at that input; finite stored endpoints and execution order need separate checks.
Architecture, bias, normalization, optimizer and classifier choices have explicit experimental scope.
